visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian woman with brown bob hair, wearing a white knit hoodie, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She holds a pink smartphone and speaks directly to the camera with a smiling expression. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the smartphone screen, where an app icon for '盡簡衣櫥' (Simple Wardrobe) is overlaid on the video frame. (3) A digital montage displays nine different outfit combinations against a white background, showcasing the app's capability to mix and match clothing. (4) The woman is now in a bedroom setting, holding a beige sweater on a white hanger. She uses her phone to take a photo of the hanging garment. (5) She kneels on a light-colored wooden floor and carefully spreads out a pink sweater to take a flat-lay photograph with her smartphone. (6) Several screen recordings of the app interface follow, showing various clothing categories such as tops, bottoms, shoes, and bags, neatly organized in a grid. (7) The interface demonstrates a background removal feature, where a white sweater is isolated from its original background. (8) The woman returns to the hallway setting, gesturing with her hands as she explains the benefits of the app, occasionally showing her phone screen to the camera. (9) Final screen recordings show her selecting specific items to create a virtual outfit, including a striped shirt, blue jeans, and black loafers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in a friendly, conversational tone in Traditional Chinese. Background music consisting of a cheerful acoustic guitar and piano melody plays at a steady moderate tempo. (2) The narrator explains her goal of organizing her wardrobe for upcoming travel. The audio remains clear with a high signal-to-noise ratio. A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound effect marks a visual change. (3) Soft fabric rustling sounds are heard as the narrator describes the process of laying out her clothes on the floor. The BGM maintains a positive major-key atmosphere. (4) As digital screens are shown, short UI 'ding' sound effects punctuate the selection of items in the app. The narrator's speech rate is energetic and clear. (5) The speaker concludes her review with a lighthearted comment about her physical tiredness, accompanied by the same upbeat background music until the end.
